sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.45 per unit (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we cannot provide a detailed internal cost breakdown due to company policy, we can confirm that material and labor are the primary drivers of our pricing. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.63 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the upward movement in your proposed price. In response, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.61 per unit while maintaining your requested 90-day payment term and 24-month contract. This represents a further concession on our part to help bridge the gap between our positions.

To be precise, our offer comprises a price of €5.61 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are always glad to work with you and support your operations with our extensive service and material range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your response. We acknowledge your revised offer, though the upward movement is very slight. We are always eager to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable service, so to keep the negotiation moving, we can reduce our price to €5.59 per unit for the 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms.

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot presents a unit price of €5.59 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We request a more substantial step from your side to help us reach a mutually beneficial agreement. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
